We could not light de shrines on de way to de temple. But now dat Jan'alai's presence is here...

Maybe now we can.

I will take de ember to de hash'ey shrines. Den maybe de trial will start.

I jumped from de top of de temple of Akil'zon. I found my way through de mists of Halazzi.

I am ready for Jan'alai's fire.

We can only hope dey will receive us after what my grandfather has done.
objectives: Assist Zul'jarra in lighting Hash'ey Shrines of Jan'alai.
progress: No stoppin' de trial now. We must do what needs to be done.

Ring of Doubt

46g 80s
16,940 XP
title: Seer or Sear

completion:
Fittin' that de last test be facin' my own doubt. About my leadership and my choices.

It felt good. As if de doubt melted away.

And I gotta say... I never seen flames so fit and handsome.

<Zul'jarra, despite it all, laughs heartily and claps you on the shoulder.>
description:
First my grandfather, then my brother.

Jan'alai knew my shame at my grandfather's rage. And de rage I feel when Zul'jan disrespects me. I know I put fuel on his fire by respondin' de way I do.

Maybe dat needs to change. I have left my doubt of de loa behind me. I can leave those thoughts behind too, and continue de path of de hash'ey.

Stoke de coal, <name>. I am ready for de final trial, whatever it may be.
objectives: Slay the last Fire Manifestation in the Temple of Jan'alai.
progress: Let's get dis over with.
rewards:
You will receive:
46g 80s
16,940 XP
title: Face in the Fire

completion:
We did it, hash'ura.

Jan'alai is reborn! And we have her blessin'.

<Zul'jarra closes her eyes and briefly enjoys the feeling of the flame against her face.>
description:
De coal... it's white-hot now. And I feel like there is somethin' inside it?

Brek said dis was de last trial. But Jan'alai is not here.

What do we do now?

<Zul'jarra looks at Brek and scowls.>

Talk to Brek and see if he's got anything to say we can understand.
progress: If I cannot commune with Jan'alai, de path of de hash'ey stops at dis temple.
rewards:

Blessing: Jan'alai's Everburn

2g 34s
1,705 XP
title: The Flames Rise Higher

completion: So many dead...
description:
Jan'alai's trial has made me realize...

I need to make things right between me and my brother.

He acts out at me, but it's because I put him down. I do not think about how hard it must be to be my brother.

We should also check on how our preparations are goin' and if my troops are gettin' de food and rest dey need.

Nalorakk's not gonna go anywhere. He can wait a few hours.
next: Den of Nalorakk: A Taste of Vengeance
rewards:
You will receive:
2g 34s
1,705 XP
title: In the Shadow of Rebirth

completion:
I love my brother. We are as de day is to de night. But even so, as children we were close.

Zul'jan is smart but he doesn't understand. A victory means nothin' if there is no one left to celebrate it.

He is supposed to be my right hand, not a pain in de neck.

I hope I have not left Zul'jan without guidance too long to turn him around.
description:
Zul'jan has taken de troops without my orders--again!

And de number of casualties... for what? For wood?

I want to take his tusks and...

<Zul'jarra growls but seems to center herself.>

Kinduru will need help with de soldiers' death rites. Help him prepare de herb mixture and pour it onto de fires.

My brother and I need to... talk.
next: Den of Nalorakk: Waking de Bear

progress: There are so few of us left. What was my brother thinking?
rewards:
You will receive:
23g 40s
13,530 XP
title: Den of Nalorakk: A Taste of Vengeance

completion:
I do not pity Lilaju--I was around her age when I took my place as leader of de Amani.

I am proud of her. She is stickin' up for herself and her tribe.

She gave us what we needed. And I will not go back on my promise of helping her.
description:
We must set aside what Zul'jan has done and focus on de final hash'ey trial: facin' Nalorakk, de Loa of War.

De Revantusk were once beloved of Nalorakk. Legend has it dat his loa speaker was so devoted, she followed him into his temple and his den with de most faithful of de Revantusk's warriors.

But now de temple is sealed. We cannot speak to de loa speaker, but maybe Lilaju knows how to get Nalorakk's attention.

She keeps watch for de Twilight's Blade at Torntusk Overlook with her guards.
objectives: Travel to Torntusk Overlook and speak with Lilaju, the Revantusk leader.
prev: Den of Nalorakk: A Taste of Vengeance
progress: Lilaju is de only person who can help us now.

You will receive:
23g 40s
13,530 XP
title: Den of Nalorakk: Waking de Bear

completion:
Heh.

We won against Nalorakk. We passed de last trial.

My tribe will sing songs and tell stories of dis day for generations.
description:
Nalorakk is the loa of war. His trial must be a battle!

There would be no greater death for an Amani than to die in combat against de Loa of War. No greater thrill than fightin' him.

Does it not make your blood pump faster and harder in your veins, hash'ura?

<Zul'jarra lets out a feral howl and laughs.>

Come. Meet me at Nalorakk's Prowl and we will sit at his fire and face our last trial--together.

description:
We've done it, <name>. De loa are at our side once again.

Am I hash'ey? I do not know. But I do know I would not have gotten dis far without my hash'ura.

Come. We will return to Amani'Zar and tell Kinduru and Zul'jan de good news.

completion:
<Zul'jarra's piercing eyes survey the battlefield. She mutters under her breath what you can only imagine are troll profanities. You hear her say "Jan" among them.>

De battlefield is full of bodies. De bodies of my people. But there are more still in de fight!

There is time to turn de tide!
description:
With de other tribes and de loa's help, we can take de fight to de Twilight's Blade and take dem down.

Blood for blood!

completion:
That was good.

But I still thirst for more.
description:
<Zul'jarra shakes her head back and forth and jumps in place, shaking out her muscles.

She stops and turns to you, grinning broadly.>

Heh. Do you feel it, my hash'ura?

De electricity in de air? De smell of blood and fire?

My soul is leapin' to join de fight.

You ready to chop de enemy down, bathe in dey blood, and make dem pay for what dey done?

Me too.

completion:
I look forward to Lor'themar's expression when I report back.

<A slight smile creeps across Liadrin's blood-spotted jaw.>

It's bound to be worth more than my inevitable reprimanding.
description:
Though the dead litter this field, I still see plenty of Amani clinging to life.

Help me heal the injured. We'll ensure their reputation for survival continues on after this day.
progress: Every warrior healed is another sword at our side!

completion:
The sight of de loa fightin' by their side has filled our warriors with hope.

Dey remember dat dey are Amani!
description:
With de loa at our side, we can finally break de Twilight's Blade and return to Amani'Zar with Mor'duun's head.

De loa are already attackin' de main source of Mor'duun's power: summoned spheres of pure void energy.

Go to de loa and offer your assistance. When de orbs are destroyed, we can move forward and strike at Mor'duun!

Mor'duun may laugh now, holed up in de Sanctum.

But we will get de last laugh.
description:
With dey magic and dey line broken, de Twilight's Blade is losin' ground.

We must take advantage of dey turned backs.

I will lead de charge through de ravine to de Conquerer's Sanctum beyond. Mor'duun is there, keepin' his coward-body safe from our spears and axes.

He won't be safe much longer.

<Zul'jarra snorts and spits out a viscous wad of blood, broken tooth included.>

It is done.
description:
It ends here. De path of the hash'ey, my path, has led me here.

Let dis fight bring a new age for my people.

Come. It is time.

completion:
It did not occur to me dat what we would be celebratin' would be... me.

There has been no hash'ey among de Amani since before de elf and human war thousands of years ago.

It is a great honor, but one I am not sure I have yet earned.

I will strive to live up to it.
description:
Mor'duun is slain.

De Twilight's Blade will continue to plague our lands, but of dem only Mor'duun's "fodder" is left. Dey will be easy prey for us.

And now I will say somethin' my uncle would be proud of. Let us follow de teachin' of Nalorakk, de Loa of War.

De battle is over. It is time to rest--I can tell by your eyes both my hash'ura need it too.

Let us leave dis place. We can speak again back in Amani'Zar.

I was hopin' I would be able to rest.

But it looks like it's time to celebrate!

completion:
Glad I found you. Zul'jarra let me know you would be searching this area for Zul'jan, but this land is still so unfamiliar to me.

If you have found him and are finished enjoying the party, we should return to Silvermoon.
description:
I make one last request of you before you return with Liadrin to Silvermoon, hash'ura.

Find Zul'jan. None have seen him since returnin' to Amani'Zar.

On de way back here, I confronted him about takin' our soldiers to Broken Throne against my orders.

People died dat shouldn't have. I asked him what he don't understand about dat.

He didn't argue. He was blank. His body was there, but his mind?

Sometimes he seeks peace in de sound of ocean waves.

You might find him on de Skybridge.
